past_7_days.title: Silent Drill Platoon Performs at Halftime on Thursday Night Football | Texans vs. Colts
past_7_days.description:
The United States Marine Corps Silent Drill Platoon delivers an absolutely mesmerizing halftime performance that had NRG Stadium on their feet during Thursday Night Football.

What an incredible honor to host the Marine Barracks Washington DC Silent Drill Platoon at NRG Stadium during our Thursday Night Football matchup against the Indianapolis Colts. This video captures the Marines' flawless precision and discipline as they perform their signature silent drill routine in front of our home crowd in Houston.

The Silent Drill Platoon is one of the most elite ceremonial units in the United States military, known for their perfectly synchronized movements and rifle handling without any verbal commands. Their performance was a powerful tribute to our nation's servicemen and women, and the entire stadium was captivated by their skill and dedication.

This Thursday Night Football game was made even more special by this incredible halftime show that honored our military heroes. The Marines' precision and professionalism perfectly embodied the values of excellence and teamwork that we strive for as the Houston Texans.

A huge thank you to the Marine Barracks Washington DC and the Silent Drill Platoon for this unforgettable performance that our fans and players will never forget.
